fixes.explanation: Reuben and Judah are sons of Jacob (Genesis 35:23), but the text doesn't name them here. It names Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, as the two who take their swords. Jacob's other sons show up two verses later, when they come upon the slaughter (Genesis 34:27).

Gad and Asher are sons of Jacob too (Genesis 35:26), but they aren't the pair in this verse. The text names Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, as the two who take their swords. Jacob's other sons come upon the slaughter two verses later (Genesis 34:27).
